title: NiagaraMappingConfig
description: Configuration schema for the Niagara adapter mapping. Describes how representative Niagara platform operations (component/point/slot/history/alarm/schedule reads, point/slot writes, schedule updates, alarm acknowledgements, action invocations, point commands, overrides/releases, browsing/ORD resolution, and point/alarm/history subscriptions) are normalized into BASIS authorization requests. Routes match on (operation, station); '*' is a wildcard sentinel and station names are matched verbatim. Values, facets, point types, baja types, nav paths, categories, Niagara users, and Niagara roles are never template fields — they remain protocol evidence, and Niagara users/roles are never BASIS identity.

routes.description: Ordered list of route mappings. Routes are evaluated in order; the first match wins.

NiagaraRouteMapping.description: Maps a Niagara operation and station to normalized authorization semantics.

name.description: Optional human-readable route name. Must be unique across all routes in the config if non-empty.

operation.description: Niagara operation to match (platform-intent name). Use '*' to match any operation.

station.description: Station name to match verbatim (e.g. 'station-east'), or '*' to match any. Exact string comparison only — no host resolution, no supervisor topology inference.

action.description: Normalized action verb. If empty, the default operation→action map is used (READ_*→read, WRITE_POINT/WRITE_SLOT/UPDATE_SCHEDULE→write, ACK_ALARM/INVOKE_ACTION/COMMAND_POINT/OVERRIDE_POINT/RELEASE_OVERRIDE→execute, BROWSE/RESOLVE_ORD/LIST_CHILDREN→browse, SUBSCRIBE_*→subscribe). Niagara reuses the existing canonical action vocabulary — no new verbs were added.

resource_id_template.description: Template for the resource ID. May reference {operation}, {station}, {ord}, {component}, {slot}, {point}, {schedule}, {alarm}, {history} using {param} syntax. Values, facets, point types, baja types, nav paths, categories, niagara_user, and niagara_role are not available as template fields.
